name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=ui, descriptor=click_debounce_skip_count). Reflects data type (counter scalar) and exact behavior. No Ghidra address residue; no domain-ID tail. The descriptor accurately matches the disassembly (CMP/DEC byte ptr [0x51A42] gating the Space/Enter action path).
purpose: Click/keypress debounce skip counter for the Space/Enter (scancode 0x39/0x1C) action-confirm path in fd2_game_main_loop.
logic_summary: Single byte initialized to 3. On each Space/Enter confirm in fd2_game_main_loop: if count != 0, decrement it (one confirm press skipped per frame); if count == 0, spin-wait until data_fd2_chapter_chapter_init_done_flag is set (calling fd2_set_chapter_init_done_flag). Net effect: the first 3 confirm presses after program/chapter start are absorbed before the chapter-init spin-wait can fire.
datatype: uint8 (1 byte; Ghidra undefined1, accessed as byte ptr)
element_semantics: Remaining number of confirm presses to skip/debounce; counts down from initial 3 to 0.
comment_original_issue: src comment block (lines 623-629) was already accurate, precise, ASCII, and consistent with the binary (address, .object2, 1 byte, decrement-while->0 logic, writer DEC byte ptr [0x51A42], initial 0x03). No issue.
notes: Symbol confirmed at 0x00051a42 as a standalone 1-byte data item (disassembly: CMP byte ptr [0x51A42],0x0 @0x11892 READ; DEC byte ptr [0x51A42] @0x1189B READ_WRITE). The decompiler's '/* fixup to -> 00001a42 */' annotations are LE relocation notes, not a different address. Full reference-iteration confirms exactly 2 xrefs, both in fd2_game_main_loop. Adjacent bytes (0x51A43+) are the unrelated resource-filename string table (data_fd2_string_resource_filename_fdtxt_dat etc.) with their own distinct symbols; the adjacency is data-segment layout only. is_const=false because the game writes via DEC. Ghidra had no PLATE_COMMENT (null) but carried a stale PRE_COMMENT (wrong field for a data plate, plus a stale emit-phase directive trailer 'emit_action = emit_c_const ... .object2 BSS-init region'); replaced with a refined PLATE_COMMENT (src-aligned) and cleared the stale PRE_COMMENT, then saved the program. src/ui_menu/menu.c left unchanged (comment already correct).
